“And you were faint and weary” … And, … we translate … And you were thirsty [meshalhei] and weary.

“And you were faint and weary” (Deuteronomy 25:18). The term faint is referring to the thirst of the Israelites in the desert. And, in the standard Aramaic translation, we translate the verse as: And you were thirsty [meshalhei] and weary.
